coverage: The connector observes SDK transport invocations, ending at response headers or transport error.
Inter-attempt gaps include SDK handling, signing, backoff and scheduling; the exact SDK sleep decision is not separately exposed.
Previous outcome is the preceding response status or transport-error kind, not a captured SDK retry decision.
Repeated local/remote socket pairs are evidence consistent with connection reuse. DNS/TCP/TLS durations and lower-transport transparent replays are not exposed.
Network transit versus R2 service execution remains unresolved for an individual attempt.

host_phases.coverage: Forty ordered warm single-writer 8-file snapshots, after three warmups. Sequential correlation checked: one prepared response, one updateOpHeads request and one of each phase/lock/bucket operation per sample. Same source as warm-profile.json.
interpretation: Host phases are consecutive checkpoints within update_heads; validation excludes earlier prepared-body parsing, identity checks and object staging.
WAL phase includes WAL exists HEAD, encoding and immutable PUT. Index phase includes compare-and-put. Bucket timings and WAL encoding are nested, and must not be added to enclosing phase totals.
Update-heads lock hold encloses validation through acknowledgment preparation; lock hold is not additional latency.
Host local_apply updates the server jj op-heads store after durable commit. Client application is separately included in warm-profile workspace phases.

post_apply_ack_prepare is host reconciliation, sidecar update and acknowledgment preparation, not response transit or client receipt. Index-to-host-response includes local apply and acknowledgment preparation.
Admission wait is exposed at millisecond resolution, repository lock waits at microsecond resolution. Zero values do not establish absence of waits below resolution.
The trace records the storage sequence as HEAD then WAL PUT then index PUT then local apply then acknowledgment preparation; this selected workload has no overlapping publish.
No complete timer isolates all host validation/identity work; no network-versus-provider decomposition is available.
